column3: Katastrofe

column2: \nThere are now {%B:07} people living in the Hanseatic League region. That means that through your deeds the Hanseatic League has increased by 30,000 inhabitants. Ensure it increases to 90,000 inhabitants by {%D:00} to complete your mission on time.
column3: \nNu bor der {%B:07} mennesker i Hansaens omraade. Gennem jeres gerninger er Hansaen altsaa vokset med 30.000 indbyggere. Soerg for, at den vokser til 90.000 indbyggere inden {%D:00} for at fuldfoere jeres mission i tide.

column2: \nThe Hanseatic League has now grown by 20,000 inhabitants, which means that there are now {%B:07} citizens in the Hanseatic League. Increase this number to 90,000 by {%D:00}.
column3: \nHansaen er nu vokset med 20.000 indbyggere, hvilket betyder, at der nu er {%B:07} borgere i Hansaen. Oeg dette tal til 90.000 inden {%D:00}.

column2:
Thanks to your efforts, the Hanseatic League has already grown by 10,000 inhabitants. Keep it up! There are now {%B:07} citizens living in the Hanseatic League region.
You still have until {%D:00} to achieve a population of 90,000.
column3:
Takket vaere jeres indsats er Hansaen allerede vokset med 10.000 indbyggere. Bliv ved saadan! Nu bor der {%B:07} borgere i Hansaens omraade.
I har stadig til {%D:00} til at naa en befolkning paa 90.000.

column2: \nAs the Hanseatic League has been growing perceptibly again for some time, even the top traders are starting to return. Although there aren't many at the moment, more and more ships will converge on the harbours from now on, to distribute their manufactured goods.
column3: \nDa Hansaen nu i nogen tid igen er vokset maerkbart, begynder selv de store handelsmaend at vende tilbage. Selvom de endnu ikke er mange, vil der fra nu af komme flere og flere skibe til havnene for at sprede deres forarbejdede varer.

column3: Tag imod vores tak!

column3: Kampagne mislykket

column2: \nUnfortunately you have not managed to settle the required number of citizens in the Hanseatic League region. The Hanseatic League region currently has a population of {%B:07}, but your goal was 90,000. Still, you can always try again.
column3: \nDesvaerre er det ikke lykkedes jer at bosaette det kraevede antal borgere i Hansaens omraade. Omraadet har i oejeblikket {%B:07} indbyggere, men jeres maal var 90.000. I kan altid proeve igen.

column2: Pirates outside Stettin
column3: Pirater ud for Stettin

column2:
Dear {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

Now, after all the disasters of the past few weeks, Stettin is in great danger. A pirate called {%N:04} is threatening all traders who try to put in at Stettin. Soon there won't be any traders that dare to supply Stettin with the goods that we need so badly.
I have heard much of your deeds, so I now wish to ask how much you would charge to save us from this life-threatening situation?
Our ships are too weak for us to be able to catch the pirate. If you help us, you will be richly rewarded. If you don't, the pirate will lurk outside our beloved town forever.

Mayor of Stettin{%+:03}
column3:
Kaere {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

Nu, efter alle ulykkerne de seneste uger, er Stettin i stor fare. En pirat ved navn {%N:04} truer alle handelsmaend, der forsoeger at anloebe Stettin. Snart vil ingen handelsmand vove at forsyne Stettin med de varer, vi saa haardt har brug for.
Jeg har hoert meget om jeres gerninger, saa jeg vil gerne spoerge, hvad I ville tage for at redde os ud af denne livsfarlige situation.
Vores skibe er for svage til at fange piraten. Hjaelper I os, bliver I rigt beloennet. Goer I det ikke, vil piraten lure ud for vores elskede by for evigt.

Borgmesteren i Stettin{%+:03}

column2:
Dear {%R:00} {%v:00} {%n:00},

We now know who sent Rostock's saboteurs: they are from Bruges! We should teach that town a lesson it won't forget. Put together a strong fleet and attack Bruges harbour! That is the only way to make the Rostock saboteurs withdraw.
To help you, the {%R:0C} {%v:0C} {%n:0C} from Luebeck has provided a heavily armed cog. It is in Luebeck harbour, and you can collect it whenever you like.
And one more thing: to avoid unnecessary trouble, you should disguise yourself as a pirate before you attack Bruges.

The Hanseatic League council{%+:01}
column3:
Kaere {%R:00} {%v:00} {%n:00},

Nu ved vi, hvem der sendte sabotoererne i Rostock: de kommer fra Bruges! Vi boer give den by en laerestreg, den ikke glemmer. Saml en staerk flaade og angrib Bruges' havn! Kun saadan faar vi sabotoererne i Rostock til at traekke sig tilbage.
For at hjaelpe jer har {%R:0C} {%v:0C} {%n:0C} fra Luebeck stillet en tungt bevaebnet kogge til raadighed. Den ligger i Luebecks havn, og I kan hente den, naar I vil.
Og én ting til: for at undgaa unoedige besvaerligheder boer I forklaede jer som pirat, foer I angriber Bruges.

Hansaens raad{%+:01}

column2: Saboteurs
column3: Sabotoerer

column2: \nThe cowardly {%N:0A} has set out in his last few ships to sabotage the Hanseatic League, even if it kills him. You should find him as quickly as possible and finally free the Hanseatic League from his wicked deeds. He was last seen near {%t:09}.
column3: \nDen feje {%N:0A} er stukket til soes med sine sidste skibe for at sabotere Hansaen, om det saa koster ham livet. I boer finde ham hurtigst muligt og endelig befri Hansaen for hans onde gerninger. Han blev sidst set naer {%t:09}.

column2: \nThe terrible pirate, {%N:0A}, was last sighted near {%t:09}!
column3: \nDen frygtede pirat {%N:0A} blev sidst set naer {%t:09}!

column2: Thank Goodness
column3: Gudskelov

column2:
You still have trading offices in the towns of Stettin and Stockholm, although the towns are in a sorry state. You should start by building these towns, as well as Rostock, up again by supplying them with goods. You can manufacture the most important goods yourself as soon as workers start arriving in your towns again.
You should only worry about the other Hansa towns when these towns' populations have been stabilised.
column3:
I har stadig kontorer i byerne Stettin og Stockholm, selvom byerne er i en soergelig forfatning. I boer begynde med at bygge disse byer, og ogsaa Rostock, op igen ved at forsyne dem med varer. De vigtigste varer kan I selv fremstille, saa snart der igen kommer arbejdere til jeres byer.
Taenk foerst paa de andre hansestaeder, naar befolkningen i disse byer er stabiliseret.

column2:
You will have noticed that there are hardly any traders. A lot of ships have been sunk by pirates, although many others returned home when their voyages ceased to be profitable.
Don't worry - the traders will come back in due course.
Once your 3 towns are flourishing, more and more traders will start turning up again, helping you to rebuild the Hanseatic League.
column3:
I har sikkert bemaerket, at der knap er nogen handelsmaend. Mange skibe er blevet saenket af pirater, og mange andre vendte hjem, da deres rejser holdt op med at kunne betale sig.
Bare rolig: handelsmaendene kommer tilbage med tiden.
Saa snart jeres 3 byer blomstrer, vil flere og flere handelsmaend dukke op igen og hjaelpe jer med at genopbygge Hansaen.

column2:
Welcome, {%R:00} {%n:00}.

We sent a petition to all the remaining trustworthy Hanseatic League traders. When they heard that you were willing to help us to achieve our former glory, they gave what they could spare. Take this 200,000\C as a gift. Or better still: pay it back in the form of flourishing towns.
Once the traders see that you can be trusted, they are certain to put even more funds at your disposal.

Your Alderman {%F:00}{%+:01}
column3:
Velkommen, {%R:00} {%n:00}.

Vi sendte en opfordring til alle tilbagevaerende paalidelige hansehandlere. Da de hoerte, at I var villig til at hjaelpe os med at genvinde vores tidligere storhed, gav de, hvad de kunne undvaere. Tag imod disse 200.000\C som en gave. Eller endnu bedre: betal dem tilbage i form af blomstrende byer.
Saa snart handelsmaendene ser, at I er til at stole paa, vil de sikkert stille endnu flere midler til jeres raadighed.

Jeres oldermand {%F:00}{%+:01}

column2: \nAs you can see, a lot of facilities in the towns are standing empty. In places where you have trading offices, you should try to buy as many facilities as possible. But take care: don't buy more than you will be able to maintain later on. Because if there is no great demand in the towns, you will hardly have any income.
column3: \nSom I kan se, staar mange virksomheder i byerne tomme. Hvor I har kontorer, boer I forsoege at koebe saa mange virksomheder som muligt. Men vaer forsigtig: koeb ikke flere, end I senere kan holde ved lige. For er der ingen stor efterspoergsel i byerne, faar I naesten ingen indtaegter.

column2:
Grain is being considerably over-produced in Gdansk. You should buy it and fill your warehouses with it. It is sure to come in useful.
Bergen has lots of ore, Luebeck iron goods, London wool and Novgorod furs. Malmö has a lot of meat.
Buy as many of these goods as you can. They will be very useful when you are building up the Hanseatic League.
But bear in mind that you will hardly be able to sell any of these goods at present. They will only be of use to you in the future.
column3:
I Gdansk produceres der alt for meget korn. Koeb det og fyld jeres lagre med det. Det kommer helt sikkert til nytte.
Bergen har meget malm, Luebeck isenkram, London uld og Novgorod pelse. Malmö har meget koed.
Koeb saa mange af disse varer, som I kan. De bliver meget nyttige, naar I genopbygger Hansaen.
Men husk, at I for tiden naesten ikke kan saelge nogen af dem. De vil foerst vaere til nytte for jer i fremtiden.

column2:
{%7:03},

The legend of the Kobold is circulating amongst the crew again. I have heard of instances where the crew have got so worked up that they have put the whole ship in danger.
I shall be harder on the sailors than usual, so that they can get this dangerous superstition out of their heads as quickly as possible.

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

Sagnet om skibsnissen gaar igen rundt blandt besaetningen. Jeg har hoert om tilfaelde, hvor besaetninger blev saa ophidsede, at de bragte hele skibet i fare.
Jeg vil vaere haardere ved soemaendene end ellers, saa de hurtigst muligt faar denne farlige overtro ud af hovedet.

Styrmanden paa {%s:04}

column2:
{%7:03},

Once again, those gullible poltroons have picked up something about the Kobold. It is this very spirit that protects every ship, and if he should ever disembark, the ship would be lost, including its crew and cargo. You will have heard the legend that the Kobold is supposed to show himself just before he leaves the ship. But now these tars reckon they're seeing the Kobold leering out at them from behind every plank.
Morale is not at its highest, so it might be better if you took care of it yourself!

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

Endnu en gang har de godtroende krystere opfanget noget om skibsnissen. Det er netop denne aand, der beskytter hvert skib, og hvis han nogensinde gaar fra borde, er skibet tabt, med besaetning og last. I har vel hoert sagnet om, at skibsnissen skal vise sig lige foer han forlader skibet. Men nu mener disse soeulke at se nissen grine ad dem bag hver planke.
Moralen er ikke paa sit hoejeste, saa det var maaske bedre, hvis I selv tog jer af det!

Styrmanden paa {%s:04}

column2:
{%7:03},

One of the older sailors told the younger ones that the Kobold leaves any ship whose owner acts in a way that is displeasing to God.
I have managed to calm the crew down by telling them that you were renowned for your honesty throughout the entire Hanseatic League. Now everybody on board is concentrating on their duties again.

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

En af de aeldre soemaend fortalte de yngre, at skibsnissen forlader ethvert skib, hvis ejer handler paa en maade, der mishager Gud.
Jeg har faaet besaetningen beroliget ved at sige, at I er kendt i hele Hansaen for jeres aerlighed. Nu koncentrerer alle om bord sig igen om deres pligter.

Styrmanden paa {%s:04}

column2:
{%7:03},

This time, even members of our own crew say they have seen the ghost ship. And now that the crew has heard talk in the {%t:07} taverns about a ship that is long overdue, there are rumours going round that it has been captured by the 'Flying Trader'.
You will not be surprised to learn that all this unfortunate speculation has damaged the crew's morale.

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

Denne gang siger selv folk fra vores egen besaetning, at de har set spoegelsesskibet. Og nu, hvor besaetningen har hoert snak i kroerne i {%t:07} om et skib, der laenge har vaeret forsinket, gaar der rygter om, at det er blevet kapret af "Den flyvende koebmand".
Det vil ikke overraske jer, at al denne uheldige spekulation har skadet besaetningens moral.

Styrmanden paa {%s:04}

column3: Konkurrent

column2: \\\\f1_Greetings! I see you are a fine sailor who is neither afraid of death nor the Devil. I have an order that may be of interest to you, as it can make you rich. The business of an extremely upright trader from {%t:00} is being threatened so much by a competitor that he fears for his very livelihood. It appears that his rival is willing to use any possible means to bring him to financial ruin. Our friend therefore needs the help of a bold sailor who can use cannons and gunpowder to stop his adversary in his tracks. Are you in?|\\\\f1_Wonderful. But I don't want to give you any further instructions out here in public, so I'll send you more information forthwith, in a letter.
column3: \\\\f1_Vaer hilset! Jeg ser, at I er en dygtig soemand, der hverken frygter doeden eller djaevelen. Jeg har en opgave, der kan interessere jer, for den kan goere jer rig. En yderst haederlig handelsmand fra {%t:00} trues saa haardt af en konkurrent, at han frygter for selve sit levebroed. Det ser ud til, at hans rival er villig til at bruge ethvert middel for at ruinere ham. Vores ven har derfor brug for hjaelp fra en dristig soemand, der med kanoner og krudt kan standse hans modstander. Er I med?|\\\\f1_Vidunderligt. Men jeg vil ikke give jer flere instrukser her blandt folk, saa jeg sender jer straks mere besked i et brev.

column2: Competitors
column3: Konkurrenter

column2:
Marvellous!

That will please my client. You will receive {%c:01} from me as soon as {%R:08} {%V:0B} {%N:09} has one less ship in his fleet. But there's one thing you should know: don't get caught!
I'll contact you in 2 weeks - until then, best of luck.
column3:
Storartet!

Det vil glaede min opdragsgiver. I faar {%c:01} af mig, saa snart {%R:08} {%V:0B} {%N:09} har et skib mindre i sin flaade. Men én ting skal I vide: lad jer ikke fange!
Jeg kontakter jer om 2 uger; indtil da held og lykke.

column2: Stop right there!
column3: Stop der!

column2:
Stop right there!

I happen to have learned that {%R:07} {%V:0B} {%N:09} wishes misfortune on me, and that you're supposed to be causing it! And just because he wants the businesses in {%t:00} all for himself!
But what I say is: first come, first served. Don't you agree? If you do, then we should turn the tables on him! Sink one of {%R:07} {%N:09}'s ships and I'll give you double what he's offered you!
column3:
Stop der!

Jeg har tilfaeldigvis erfaret, at {%R:07} {%V:0B} {%N:09} oensker mig ulykke, og at det er jer, der skal forvolde den! Og blot fordi han vil have forretningerne i {%t:00} helt for sig selv!
Men jeg siger: foerst til moelle. Er I ikke enig? Saa lad os vende tingene mod ham! Saenk et af {%R:07} {%N:09}s skibe, saa giver jeg jer det dobbelte af, hvad han har tilbudt jer!

column2: Revenge is sweet
column3: Haevnen er soed

column2:
Good work!

Let that be a lesson to that treacherous {%N:09}! Here is a bag containing {%c:01}, as promised.
It's good to know that there are still some traders on the side of justice.
column3:
Godt arbejde!

Lad det vaere en laerestreg for den forraederiske {%N:09}! Her er en pung med {%c:01}, som lovet.
Det er godt at vide, at der stadig er handelsmaend paa retfaerdighedens side.

column2: Lesson
column3: Laerestreg

column2:
Ha, ha!

That'll teach {%N:09} to make himself at home in my business. Here are the {%c:01} as promised.
I may be in touch if I need your help again.
column3:
Ha, ha!

Det skal laere {%N:09} ikke at goere sig hjemmevant i mine forretninger. Her er de lovede {%c:01}.
Maaske kontakter jeg jer igen, hvis jeg faar brug for jeres hjaelp.

column2: Pirate hunter
column3: Piratjaeger

column2:
\\f1_Greetings,
My name is {%V:08} {%N:07}. Might you be interested in doing me a huge favour, for which I will reward you handsomely? You see, there's a certain vicious pirate to whom I once lost my most magnificent ship. After many months, I finally managed to pick up his scent. I planted a spy with him, who recently reported back to me. So now I know the pirate's secret whereabouts.
Would you be willing to visit his hiding place and get rid of him once and for all? If you could do that, it would be worth {%c:05} to me.|\\f1_Thank you. Maybe I'll be able to sleep at night if the pirate is destroyed. I'll have a map showing his whereabouts delivered to you forthwith.
column3:
\\f1_Vaer hilset,
Mit navn er {%V:08} {%N:07}. Kunne I have lyst til at goere mig en stor tjeneste, som jeg vil beloenne jer gavmildt for? Ser I, der er en vis ondskabsfuld pirat, som jeg engang mistede mit praegtigste skib til. Efter mange maaneder har jeg endelig faaet faerten af ham. Jeg placerede en spion hos ham, som for nylig aflagde rapport. Saa nu kender jeg piratens hemmelige skjulested.
Vil I opsoege hans skjulested og skaffe ham af vejen én gang for alle? Kunne I det, ville det vaere {%c:05} vaerd for mig.|\\f1_Tak. Maaske kan jeg sove om natten, hvis piraten bliver tilintetgjort. Jeg lader straks et kort over hans skjulested bringe til jer.

column2: \\\\f1_Please help me to wreak revenge on a pirate! My name is {%V:08} {%N:07} and my brother was killed recently in a sea battle with a pirate. Now I have sold all of our possessions to raise enough money for a courageous seafarer who can wipe this pirate off the face of the earth. Will you help me to avenge my brother for {%c:05}?|\\\\f1_Justice will at last be done. Take this map and find the pirate, may he never be permitted to do any more wrong in this world.\n
column3: \\\\f1_Hjaelp mig at haevne mig paa en pirat! Mit navn er {%V:08} {%N:07}, og min bror blev for nylig draebt i et soeslag mod en pirat. Nu har jeg solgt alt, hvad vi ejede, for at skaffe penge nok til en modig soefarer, der kan udslette denne pirat fra jordens overflade. Vil I hjaelpe mig med at haevne min bror for {%c:05}?|\\\\f1_Endelig skal retfaerdigheden ske fyldest. Tag dette kort og find piraten; maa han aldrig mere goere ondt i denne verden.\n

column2:
{%5:01}{%N:0D},

You have fulfilled my wishes, so I shall pay you the agreed reward of {%c:05}.
Once again, thank you!

{%V:08} {%N:07}
column3:
{%5:01}{%N:0D},

I har opfyldt mine oensker, saa jeg betaler jer den aftalte beloenning paa {%c:05}.
Endnu en gang tak!

{%V:08} {%N:07}

column2: Pirate escaped
column3: Pirat undsluppet

column2:
Curses!

I have been told that the pirate heard about our plan and found himself a new hiding place! So he has escaped because you were too slow!
So you won't be surprised if I withdraw the reward I offered you!

{%V:08} {%N:07}
column3:
Pokkers!

Jeg har faaet at vide, at piraten fik nys om vores plan og fandt et nyt skjulested! Han er altsaa undsluppet, fordi I var for langsom!
Saa det vil ikke overraske jer, at jeg traekker den beloenning tilbage, jeg tilboed jer!

{%V:08} {%N:07}

column2: Siege
column3: Belejring

column2: Courier
column3: Kurer

column2: \\\\f1_You have been recommended to me - I have heard that you are fast and reliable. I have a small problem and I would like to beg humbly for your services. I have some urgent courier work that needs to taken care of and unfortunately the captain, who gave me his word, has broken his promise and hasn't appeared.  A number of vitally important packages and documents need to be delivered to various towns. The faster you are, the more handsomely I shall pay you. If you have a ship in {%t:00} with at least 3 \\L of free storage space, we can get started.
column3: \\\\f1_I er blevet anbefalet mig; jeg har hoert, at I er hurtig og paalidelig. Jeg har et lille problem og vil ydmygt bede om jeres tjenester. Jeg har et hastende kurerarbejde, og desvaerre har kaptajnen, der gav mig sit ord, brudt sit loefte og er ikke dukket op. En raekke livsvigtige pakker og dokumenter skal leveres i forskellige byer. Jo hurtigere I er, desto gavmildere betaler jeg jer. Har I et skib i {%t:00} med mindst 3 \\L fri lastplads, kan vi gaa i gang.

column2: Take cargo
column3: Tag last

column2: \nUnfortunately I was unable to find a ship in {%t:00} that would have 3 \\L of free space.
column3: \nDesvaerre kunne jeg ikke finde et skib i {%t:00} med 3 \\L fri plads.

column2: Let's go
column3: Af sted

column2:
Come on,

The cargo is on board and the sails are awaiting good winds.
The first place I need to be is {%t:00}. Please take me there as fast as the currents of fate will allow.
I shall be meeting a trader when we arrive in {%t:00}. In the meantime, drop anchor in the harbour until I tell you the next destination on our voyage.
Don't forget: the faster I travel, the higher my payment will be - and your share too.

Courier on board the {%s:05}
column3:
Kom saa,

Lasten er om bord, og sejlene venter paa god vind.
Det foerste sted, jeg skal hen, er {%t:00}. Foer mig derhen saa hurtigt, som skaebnens stroemme tillader.
Jeg skal moedes med en handelsmand, naar vi ankommer til {%t:00}. Imens kaster I anker i havnen, indtil jeg fortaeller jer naeste maal for vores rejse.
Glem ikke: jo hurtigere jeg rejser, desto hoejere bliver min betaling, og jeres andel ogsaa.

Kureren om bord paa {%s:05}

column2: Carry on please...
column3: Videre, tak...

column2: Payment
column3: Betaling

column2:
My courier voyage ends here.

Today I shall disembark, taking the remaining packages with me. After that I shall not require your services any more, as I intend to pay a social visit on an old acquaintance.
May I take this opportunity to thank you for the speedy transportation.
I am sure that the sum of {%c:03} will strike you as ample reward for your trouble. 
I bow to you with the greatest respect.
Yours sincerely,

Courier on board the {%s:05}
column3:
Min kurerrejse slutter her.

I dag gaar jeg fra borde og tager de resterende pakker med mig. Derefter har jeg ikke laengere brug for jeres tjenester, da jeg har taenkt mig at aflaegge en gammel bekendt et besoeg.
Lad mig benytte lejligheden til at takke jer for den hurtige transport.
Jeg er sikker paa, at summen {%c:03} forekommer jer en rigelig beloenning for ulejligheden.
Jeg bukker for jer med den stoerste respekt.
Med venlig hilsen,

Kureren om bord paa {%s:05}

column2: Too slow
column3: For langsom

column2:
What a blemish on your reputation!

I must say, this is by far the slowest voyage I have ever made. The next time I think I'd rather travel over hill and dale on an ox-cart or even propel myself through the waves with my own arms than travel with you again!
Now for your payment: its value is equal to that of your word and your reputation - naught. Didn't I make it clear to you when we started our voyage that I was in a hurry?
Too bad. 

Farewell and may we never meet again!
column3:
Hvilken plet paa jeres omdoemme!

Jeg maa sige, at dette er langt den langsomste rejse, jeg nogensinde har foretaget. Naeste gang vil jeg hellere rejse over bjerg og dal i en oksekaerre, eller endda svoemme gennem boelgerne ved egen kraft, end rejse med jer igen!
Og saa jeres betaling: den er lige saa meget vaerd som jeres ord og jeres omdoemme, nemlig intet. Gjorde jeg det ikke klart for jer ved rejsens begyndelse, at jeg havde travlt?
Oev.

Farvel, og maa vi aldrig moedes igen!

column2: Treasure map
column3: Skattekort

column2:
\\f1_Greetings,
Now that the light in my eyes is growing dim and eternal rest awaits me, I shall let you into a little secret. Many years ago, when I was chasing a pirate for the Hanseatic League, an influential long distance merchant's ship sank. I later found out that the ship was carrying a valuable cargo. Gold and jewels were said to lie in the watery grave. Unfortunately I never managed to salvage this treasure. Give me a small contribution of {%c:01} to make my twilight years a little sweeter and I'll give you my part of the treasure map.
Are you interested?|\\f1_Thank you, and good luck.
column3:
\\f1_Vaer hilset,
Nu, hvor lyset i mine oejne svinder og den evige hvile venter, vil jeg indvie jer i en lille hemmelighed. For mange aar siden, da jeg jagede en pirat for Hansaen, sank en indflydelsesrig fjernhandlers skib. Senere fandt jeg ud af, at skibet havde en kostbar last. Guld og juveler skulle ligge i den vaade grav. Desvaerre lykkedes det mig aldrig at bjaerge skatten. Giv mig et lille bidrag paa {%c:01} til at forsoede mit otium, saa giver jeg jer min del af skattekortet.
Er I interesseret?|\\f1_Tak, og held og lykke.

column2: Buy
column3: Koeb

column2:
\\f1_Ahoy there, moneybags,
Pay attention - you're going to have a little adventure. Many years ago, I signed up for the {%Q:05}. Our captain didn't say much about the cargo. But when we were lying in our bunks at night, we would hear muttering about treasure. However, the ship was rotting and couldn't withstand the rigours of the long voyage. It sank, and many sailors and even the captain went with it. I have never had the means to look for the treasure myself. But I'm prepared to sell you my part of the map for the paltry amount of {%c:01}.
Interested?|\\f1_Well, take this piece of my map, then, and I wish you every success.
column3:
\\f1_Ohoej, pengepung,
Hoer efter, nu skal I opleve et lille eventyr. For mange aar siden moenstrede jeg paa {%Q:05}. Vores kaptajn sagde ikke meget om lasten. Men naar vi laa i koejerne om natten, hoerte vi mumlen om en skat. Skibet var dog raadnet og kunne ikke klare strabadserne paa den lange rejse. Det sank, og mange soemaend og endda kaptajnen gik ned med det. Jeg har aldrig haft midler til selv at lede efter skatten. Men jeg er villig til at saelge jer min del af kortet for den soelle sum af {%c:01}.
Interesseret?|\\f1_Naa, saa tag dette stykke af mit kort, og jeg oensker jer al mulig held.

column2:
{%7:03},

The nine pieces of the map were divided amongst the crew, and we vanished to all four corners of the earth. I've no idea where the other pieces are, but keep your eyes open in the taverns.

Good luck
column3:
{%7:03},

Kortets ni stykker blev delt mellem besaetningen, og vi forsvandt til alle verdenshjoerner. Jeg aner ikke, hvor de andre stykker er, men hold oejnene aabne i kroerne.

Held og lykke

column2: Treasure recovered
column3: Skat bjaerget

column2:
Congratulations!

Your ship, {%s:05}, has found treasure worth {%c:08}!
column3:
Tillykke!

Jeres skib {%s:05} har fundet en skat til en vaerdi af {%c:08}!

column2: Treasure lost
column3: Skat tabt

column2:
{%7:03},

Unfortunately, rumour has it that the treasure you were hoping to salvage has been found by another intrepid seafarer.
Presumably another trader was interested in the pieces of the map, so there is no more point in chasing after the treasure.
column3:
{%7:03},

Desvaerre gaar rygtet, at den skat, I haabede at bjaerge, er fundet af en anden dristig soefarer.
Formentlig var en anden handelsmand interesseret i kortstykkerne, saa der er ingen grund til at jagte skatten laengere.

column2: Smuggler
column3: Smugler

column2:
\\f1_Do you want to earn a little something on the side? I might have an order for you - just a quick job but very well paid, if you have a ship with {%B:03}{%E:01} of free storage space. What do you say?|\\f1_Can you hear the call of gold?
Bring a ship with {%B:03}{%E:01} of free storage space to {%t:00} harbour within 10 days. You will then receive a number of packages that you should take unnoticed to {%t:05} within 10 days. And just remember, we've never met! I'll send you a letter with my order in it, too.
And I'll just give you one piece of advice before you go: make sure you load other goods onto your ship, so that these packages won't be so easily discovered.
column3:
\\f1_Vil I tjene lidt ved siden af? Jeg har maaske en opgave til jer: et hurtigt job, men meget godt betalt, hvis I har et skib med {%B:03}{%E:01} fri lastplads. Hvad siger I?|\\f1_Kan I hoere guldet kalde?
Foer et skib med {%B:03}{%E:01} fri lastplads til havnen i {%t:00} inden 10 dage. Der faar I nogle pakker, som I ubemaerket skal bringe til {%t:05} inden 10 dage. Og husk: vi har aldrig moedt hinanden! Jeg sender jer ogsaa et brev med min opgave.
Og et raad, foer I gaar: soerg for ogsaa at laste andre varer paa jeres skib, saa pakkerne ikke saa let bliver opdaget.

column3:
Hoer!

I hentede ikke engang mine pakker i {%t:00}. Har I virkelig den fraekhed at lade mig i stikken saadan?
I kan vaere sikker paa, at jeg ikke glemmer det lige med det samme.

column2:
Hey!

Where did you get to with my goods for {%t:05}?
May you be ensnared by a ravenous sea-monster, you unreliable greedyguts.
column3:
Hoer!

Hvor blev I af med mine varer til {%t:05}?
Maa et graadigt soeuhyre fange jer, upaalidelige grovaeder.

column2: Failure
column3: Fiasko

column2:
Now that's what I call failure. Well, I presume the goods have gone.
And your good reputation with them.
column3:
Det kalder jeg en fiasko. Naa, jeg gaar ud fra, at varerne er vaek.
Og jeres gode navn med dem.

column2: Packages collected
column3: Pakker leveret

column2:
As you have taken the goods to {%t:05} unnoticed and undamaged, I shall reward you promptly. 
I herewith send you {%c:04}, and may the Kobold never cast a shadow on your life.
column3:
Da I har bragt varerne til {%t:05} ubemaerket og ubeskadiget, beloenner jeg jer prompte.
Hermed sender jeg jer {%c:04}, og maa skibsnissen aldrig kaste en skygge over jeres liv.

column2: Donation
column3: Gave

column2:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

I am contacting you to appeal to your magnanimous nature. I run a children's refuge here in {%t:02} for our town's poor and unwanted cherubs.
However, I currently have to rely on donations, as I cannot cover all the costs incurred myself. Would you help us by donating the {%c:04} that we need so urgently?
Obviously I cannot offer you anything in return, but it is not only the town's children who will look favourably upon this act.

{%V:06} {%N:05}
column3:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

Jeg henvender mig til jer for at appellere til jeres storsind. Jeg driver her i {%t:02} et boernehjem for vores bys fattige og uoenskede smaa engle.
For tiden er jeg dog afhaengig af gaver, da jeg ikke selv kan daekke alle omkostningerne. Vil I hjaelpe os ved at skaenke de {%c:04}, vi saa haardt har brug for?
Naturligvis kan jeg ikke tilbyde jer noget til gengaeld, men det er ikke kun byens boern, der vil se med velvilje paa denne gerning.

{%V:06} {%N:05}

column2: Donate
column3: Skaenk

column2:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

My name is {%V:06} {%N:05} and I run the sailors' home in {%t:02}. We take in sailors who can no longer work and who have no one else to turn to. Of course, this responsibility brings with it a lot of expense. We therefore have to rely on donations by our town's more generous residents. Would you donate {%c:04} to us, to help us to get by over the next few weeks?
The inhabitants of this town will certainly look favourably upon this deed too. Please decide within the next week, as the money is needed urgently.
column3:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

Mit navn er {%V:06} {%N:05}, og jeg driver soemandshjemmet i {%t:02}. Vi tager imod soemaend, der ikke laengere kan arbejde og ikke har andre at gaa til. Dette ansvar medfoerer naturligvis store udgifter. Derfor er vi afhaengige af gaver fra byens mere gavmilde indbyggere. Vil I skaenke os {%c:04} for at hjaelpe os gennem de naeste uger?
Byens indbyggere vil helt sikkert ogsaa se med velvilje paa denne gerning. Beslut jer venligst inden for en uge, for pengene behoeves hurtigt.

column2:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

I am the Head of Fine Arts here in {%t:02}. But we cannot support our new talent without donations from generous citizens. Would you be prepared to donate the required sum of {%c:04} to us? And a donation will certainly earn you the respect of this town's many art lovers.
We would be very grateful if you would give us your reply within the next seven days.
{%V:06} {%N:05}
column3:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

Jeg er forstander for de skoenne kunster her i {%t:02}. Men vi kan ikke stoette vores unge talenter uden gaver fra gavmilde borgere. Vil I vaere villig til at skaenke os den noedvendige sum paa {%c:04}? En gave vil helt sikkert skaffe jer respekt hos byens mange kunstelskere.
Vi ville vaere meget taknemmelige, hvis I gav os jeres svar inden for de naeste syv dage.
{%V:06} {%N:05}

column2: Goods transport
column3: Varetransport

column2:
Why didn't you pick my goods up in {%t:00}? If you carry on like this, you'll never get anywhere.
And now I'm off to look for another trader.

Farewell
column3:
Hvorfor hentede I ikke mine varer i {%t:00}? Fortsaetter I saadan, kommer I aldrig nogen vegne.
Og nu gaar jeg ud for at finde en anden handelsmand.

Farvel

column2: Goods transportation
column3: Transport af varer

column2: \nThe packages have just been loaded on to the {%s:07}. Would you now please set sail for {%t:05} as quickly as possible.
column3: \nPakkerne er netop blevet lastet paa {%s:07}. Saet nu kurs mod {%t:05} saa hurtigt som muligt.

column2:
Where are my goods? They haven't arrived in {%t:05} and now I can't even sell the product any more. You might as well throw it overboard, along with any hopes you might have of a reward.

Farewell
column3:
Hvor er mine varer? De er ikke naaet frem til {%t:05}, og nu kan jeg ikke engang saelge produktet laengere. I kan lige saa godt kaste det over bord, sammen med ethvert haab om beloenning.

Farvel

column2: Goods collected
column3: Varer leveret

column2:
Marvellous. You took my goods to {%t:05} quickly and safely. And as I promised you at the start, this has not been to your disadvantage. Have these {%c:04} as compensation for your trouble.

God be with you, and may Fortune continue to smile upon you.
column3:
Storartet. I har bragt mine varer til {%t:05} hurtigt og sikkert. Og som jeg lovede jer fra begyndelsen, har det ikke vaeret til jeres skade. Tag imod disse {%c:04} som erstatning for ulejligheden.

Gud vaere med jer, og maa lykken fortsat smile til jer.

column2: Hiding goods
column3: Skjule varer

column2:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Are you an old war-horse like me? If you are, you will certainly appreciate that people like us can sometimes find themselves in a bit of a fix. This is exactly whats happend to me and I ask you for your help.
Could you keep a few of my goods in your warehouse? It wouldn't be for very long and would work to your advantage.
Decide within 10 days.

A man of honour
column3:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Er I en gammel krigshest som mig? Saa forstaar I sikkert, at folk som os somme tider kan komme i knibe. Det er praecis, hvad der er sket mig, og jeg beder jer om hjaelp.
Kunne I opbevare nogle af mine varer i jeres lager? Det ville ikke vaere laenge og ville vaere til jeres fordel.
Beslut jer inden 10 dage.

En aeresmand

column2:
{%N:05},

I shan't make a lot of fuss - I'll just come straight to the point. I need to hide my goods and your warehouse would be just the job.
In return, I can offer you more gold than you could hold in your hands.
Decide within 10 days.

A man of honour
column3:
{%N:05},

Jeg vil ikke goere et stort nummer ud af det, men gaar lige til sagen. Jeg maa skjule mine varer, og jeres lager ville vaere lige sagen.
Til gengaeld kan jeg tilbyde jer mere guld, end I kan holde i haenderne.
Beslut jer inden 10 dage.

En aeresmand

column2: Delivery of goods
column3: Varelevering

column2:
Thank you,

for your help, which is greatly appreciated. I have already had my goods sent to your warehouse in {%t:04}. They should arrive in {%B:01}{%e:07} in 7 days, packaged and barely distinguishable from packs of {%W:07}.
But I must warn you: people are already looking for my goods. The best camouflage would be for you to put them with another load of {%W:07}.
I'll collect the goods again in about 2 weeks, which is when you'll get paid.
column3:
Tak

for jeres hjaelp, som jeg saetter stor pris paa. Jeg har allerede ladet mine varer sende til jeres lager i {%t:04}. Om 7 dage burde {%B:01}{%e:07} ankomme, pakket ind og knap til at skelne fra baller med {%W:07}.
Men jeg maa advare jer: man leder allerede efter mine varer. Den bedste camouflage ville vaere at laegge dem sammen med en anden last {%W:07}.
Jeg henter varerne igen om cirka 2 uger, og saa faar I jeres betaling.

column2: Receipt of goods
column3: Modtagelse af varer

column2:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

My goods should now be arriving in your trading office. I hope you have made all the necessary preparations.

The man of honour
column3:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Mine varer burde nu ankomme til jeres kontor. Jeg haaber, at I har truffet alle noedvendige forberedelser.

Aeresmanden

column2: Loss of goods
column3: Tab af varer

column2:
You miserable good-for-nothing,

I did warn you but I'm not going to lose any sleep over you. All you needed to do was hide my goods among your own. And what did you do?
Don't expect a single gold coin for this absolutely disgraceful attempt at carrying out my instructions!
column3:
I elendige doegenigt,

Jeg advarede jer, men jeg vil ikke miste nattesoevnen over jer. I skulle bare skjule mine varer blandt jeres egne. Og hvad gjorde I?
Forvent ikke en eneste guldmoent for dette aldeles skaendige forsoeg paa at foelge mine instrukser!

column2:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Thank you for looking after my goods. I think you have fulfilled my request extremely satisfactorily, so I hope you will consider {%c:02} to be acceptable compensation.

The man of honour
column3:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Tak fordi I passede paa mine varer. Jeg synes, at I har opfyldt min anmodning yderst tilfredsstillende, saa jeg haaber, at I vil anse {%c:02} for en acceptabel godtgoerelse.

Aeresmanden

column3:
\\f1_Ah, velkommen!

I ser ud som en, der kunne vaere interesseret i en paen fortjeneste. Men lad mig foerst praesentere mig. Mit navn er {%V:07} {%N:06}, og jeg er handelsmand ligesom jer.

I collected the goods from your trading office today and transferred the agreed amount to you.

{%V:07} {%N:06}

column2: Delivery?

Now I'll have to go and look for another trader who's more reliable!
Farewell.

{%V:07} {%N:06}
column3:
Hvor er min levering? Aah, jeg vidste, at jeg ikke kunne stole paa jer.
Nu maa jeg ud og finde en anden, mere paalidelig handelsmand!
Farvel.

{%V:07} {%N:06}

Jeg ville blot lade jer vide, at jeg har byttet mine {%B:17} {%w:19} med {%R:1B} {%v:1B} {%n:1B}.
Han tilboed mig i alt {%B:1A} {%w:18} i bytte for mine {%B:17} {%w:19}.

column2: Reputation
column3: Anseelse

column2:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

Don't be too alarmed by this letter, as it is not particularly serious. But it could certainly be worth your while to take notice of what is written here. For some time now, there has been a competition underway between certain members of the Hanseatic League council. The question is: who is the more competent trader, you or your rival, the {%R:04} {%V:04} {%N:04}?
As we have not managed to obtain a clear picture of either contestant's superiority so far, we would like to put the following to you: you must gain fame and recognition among the residents of a town of our choosing, within 50 days. The one with the better reputation at the end of this period will be the winner and will receive a lovely sackful of gold. And the more successful you are, the bigger the prize will be that you take home with you.
You will not find out which town you will need to vanquish until both parties have agreed to the conditions.
Oh, and one more thing: to increase your resolve, a stake of {%c:0C} is required, which will be taken from your account as soon as the contest begins.
Please reply to this within 10 days.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

Bliv ikke alt for forskraekket over dette brev, det er ikke noget alvorligt. Men det kan sikkert betale sig at laegge maerke til, hvad der staar her. I nogen tid har der vaeret en konkurrence mellem visse medlemmer af Hansaens raad. Spoergsmaalet er: hvem er den dygtigste handelsmand, I eller jeres rival, {%R:04} {%V:04} {%N:04}?
Da vi indtil nu ikke har kunnet danne os et klart billede af nogen af parternes overlegenhed, foreslaar vi foelgende: I skal vinde beroemmelse og anerkendelse blandt indbyggerne i en by efter vores valg, inden for 50 dage. Den, der har den bedste anseelse ved periodens slutning, vinder og faar en dejlig saek guld. Og jo mere succes I har, desto stoerre bliver praemien, I tager med hjem.
Hvilken by I skal erobre, faar I foerst at vide, naar begge parter har accepteret betingelserne.
Aah, og én ting til: for at styrke jeres beslutsomhed kraeves en indsats paa {%c:0C}, som traekkes fra jeres konto, saa snart konkurrencen begynder.
Svar venligst inden 10 dage.

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2:
{%1:04}{%R:04} {%n:04},

Don't be too alarmed by this letter, as it is not particularly serious. But it could certainly be worth your while to take notice of what is written here. For some time now, there has been a bet between certain members of the Hanseatic League council. The question is: who is the more competent trader, you or your rival, the {%R:03} {%V:03} {%N:03}?
As we have not managed to obtain a clear picture of either contestant's superiority so far, we would like to put the following to you: you must gain fame and recognition among the residents of a town of our choosing, within 50 days. The one with the better reputation at the end of this period will be the winner and will receive a lovely sackful of gold. And the more successful you are, the bigger the prize will be that you take home with you.
You will not find out which town you will need to vanquish until both parties have agreed to the conditions.
Oh, and one more thing: to increase your resolve, a stake of {%c:0D} is required, which will be taken from your account as soon as the contest begins.
Please reply to this within 10 days.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}

Den, der har den bedste anseelse ved periodens slutning, vinder og faar en dejlig saek guld. Og jo mere succes I har, desto stoerre bliver praemien, I tager med hjem.

column2: Refusal
column3: Afslag

column2:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%n:02},

Your opponent became thoroughly uneasy at the thought of competing against you. That means our little contest can't take place after all. But it evidently isn't necessary anyway, as it is clear who would have won...

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%n:02},

Jeres modstander blev helt utilpas ved tanken om at konkurrere mod jer. Vores lille konkurrence kan altsaa ikke finde sted alligevel. Men den er aabenbart heller ikke noedvendig, for det er klart, hvem der ville have vundet...

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2: The race is on!
column3: Kaploebet begynder!

column2:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02},

Your opponent has also agreed to the terms.
So we will tell you the conditions: your town will be {%t:07}. Increase your reputation in this town through trade and donations and see to it that you achieve a better reputation than your opponent within 50 days. Then victory will be yours.
Incidentally, your stake has already been taken from your account.
Good luck,

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02},

Ogsaa jeres modstander har accepteret betingelserne.
Saa her er reglerne: jeres by bliver {%t:07}. Oeg jeres anseelse i byen gennem handel og gaver, og soerg for at opnaa en bedre anseelse end jeres modstander inden for 50 dage. Saa er sejren jeres.
Jeres indsats er i oevrigt allerede trukket fra jeres konto.
Held og lykke,

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2: Won
column3: Vundet

column2:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

There is no longer any doubt about your reputation in {%t:07}: you have won our competition. You have developed a better reputation than your opponent within the allotted time. The {%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02} must admit defeat, and the prize money is yours. The sum is linked to your results, and comes to a total of {%c:00}.
And perhaps you should consider continuing to look after this town...

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

Der er ikke laengere tvivl om jeres anseelse i {%t:07}: I har vundet vores konkurrence. I har opnaaet en bedre anseelse end jeres modstander inden for den fastsatte tid. {%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02} maa erkende sit nederlag, og praemiepengene er jeres. Summen afhaenger af jeres resultater og beloeber sig i alt til {%c:00}.
Og maaske burde I overveje at blive ved med at tage jer af denne by...

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2: Lost
column3: Tabt

column2:
{%1:04}{%R:04} {%n:04},

You have been defeated! Your opponent, the victorious {%R:03} {%V:03} {%N:03}, has managed to develop a better reputation than you over the last 50 days, so he walks off with the prize money and your stake too!
But despite everything, please rest assured that the citizens of {%t:07} have benefited from your involvement and extend their gratitude to you.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:04}{%R:04} {%n:04},

I er blevet besejret! Jeres modstander, den sejrrige {%R:03} {%V:03} {%N:03}, har formaaet at opnaa en bedre anseelse end jer i loebet af de sidste 50 dage og gaar derfor med praemiepengene og ogsaa jeres indsats!
Men vaer trods alt forvisset om, at borgerne i {%t:07} har haft gavn af jeres engagement og er jer taknemmelige.

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2:
Dear traders,

Some people consider me to be old and a bit strange. That's as may be, and yet I am also rich, very rich. To help me pass the time, I'd like to suggest a little game for you and some other traders to play. The rules are very simple.
Some time ago I had a chest hidden, which is now waiting to be discovered. There are coins galore twinkling inside it, but who will be the one to open it? I had its exact location marked on a map and then had several different versions of the map prepared, which I tore into pieces and scattered around all over the place.
The first person to find enough of these pieces will have no trouble locating the treasure. You have 6 weeks to do it.
Send me {%c:1C} to express your interest and I'll count you in for the game. You will then be sent the first piece of the map a few days later. But you need to decide within a week.

Yours graciously,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}
column3:
Kaere handelsmaend,

Nogle anser mig for gammel og lidt underlig. Det kan godt vaere, men jeg er ogsaa rig, meget rig. For at faa tiden til at gaa vil jeg foreslaa jer og nogle andre handelsmaend en lille leg. Reglerne er meget enkle.
For nogen tid siden lod jeg en kiste gemme, som nu venter paa at blive fundet. Den funkler af moenter i massevis, men hvem bliver den, der aabner den? Jeg lod dens noejagtige placering afmaerke paa et kort og fik derefter lavet flere forskellige udgaver af kortet, som jeg rev i stykker og spredte vidt omkring.
Den foerste, der finder nok af disse stykker, vil ikke have svaert ved at finde skatten. I har 6 uger til det.
Send mig {%c:1C} som tegn paa jeres interesse, saa regner jeg jer med i legen. Nogle dage senere faar I det foerste kortstykke. Men I skal beslutte jer inden for en uge.

Naadigst,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}

column2:
Congratulations!

The trader {%R:03} {%v:03} {%n:03} has recovered my treasure! So he has certainly earned the {%c:01}.
I have thoroughly enjoyed watching you searching for the treasure, and it was definitely worth every gold coin.

{%V:1A} {%N:19}
column3:
Tillykke!

Handelsmanden {%R:03} {%v:03} {%n:03} har fundet min skat! Saa han har bestemt fortjent de {%c:01}.
Jeg har moret mig storartet med at se jer lede efter skatten, og det var bestemt hver guldmoent vaerd.

{%V:1A} {%N:19}

column2:
Dear traders,

Unfortunately, none of the traders has managed to complete my little task within a reasonable time and I am now tired of waiting.
I shall recover the chest again myself and use its contents for a worthy cause.

Farewell,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}
column3:
Kaere handelsmaend,

Desvaerre er det ikke lykkedes nogen af handelsmaendene at loese min lille opgave inden for rimelig tid, og nu er jeg traet af at vente.
Jeg henter selv kisten igen og bruger indholdet til et godt formaal.

Farvel,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}

column2: Race
column3: Kapsejlads

column2:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Some members of the Hanseatic League council would like to organise a race to find out which trader is the fastest.
Would you be interested in taking part? If you do enter, your stake will be 3,000\C, which will be taken from your account before the race begins.
You must make your decision within 10 days. You will also receive further information after this period.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:12}
column3:

Nogle medlemmer af Hansaens raad vil gerne arrangere en kapsejlads for at finde ud af, hvilken handelsmand der er hurtigst.
Kunne I taenke jer at deltage? Hvis I tilmelder jer, er jeres indsats 3.000\C, som traekkes fra jeres konto, foer kapsejladsen begynder.
I skal traeffe jeres beslutning inden 10 dage. Efter denne frist faar I ogsaa yderligere oplysninger.

Hansaens raad.

column2: Tutorial
column3: Introduktion

column2: Operating the game interface
column3: Betjening af spillets brugerflade

column2: In this part of the tutorial, you will learn about the basic principles of using the game interface.
column3: I denne del af introduktionen laerer I de grundlaeggende principper for betjening af spillets brugerflade.

column2: Ships
column3: Skibe

column2: Ships are the basic capital of every travelling merchant. Travelling, as well as the hiring of sailors and captains will be explained. Ship building and repairing will also be described.
column3: Skibe er enhver rejsende koebmands grundkapital. Rejser samt hyring af soemaend og kaptajner forklares. Skibsbygning og reparation beskrives ogsaa.

column2: Trading
column3: Handel

column2: In this, the most important part of all, you will be told everything worth knowing about trading. This includes, purchasing, selling and the transportation of goods, as well as the system of offers, supply & demand, requirements and consumption. This knowledge will make you into a successful trader.
column3: I denne, den vigtigste del af alle, faar I at vide alt, hvad der er vaerd at vide om handel: indkoeb, salg og transport af varer samt systemet med udbud, efterspoergsel, behov og forbrug. Denne viden vil goere jer til en succesfuld handelsmand.

column2: Building towns
column3: Byggeri i byer

column2: A town is essentially divided into municipal buildings, houses and production facilities. As a simple trader, you can build houses to provide living quarters for new citizens. Building production facilities allows you not only bring those looking for work from the countryside into the town but also allows you to produce raw materials and goods.
column3: En by bestaar i det vaesentlige af kommunale bygninger, huse og produktionsanlaeg. Som simpel handelsmand kan I bygge huse for at give nye borgere bolig. Ved at bygge produktionsanlaeg traekker I ikke blot arbejdssoegende fra landet ind til byen, men kan ogsaa producere raavarer og varer.

column2: Sea battles
column3: Soeslag

column2: In this last part of the tutorial, you will learn how to manoeuvre a ship during a sea battle as well as how to board enemy ships.
column3: I denne sidste del af introduktionen laerer I at manoevrere et skib under et soeslag og at entre fjendtlige skibe.

column2: The advancement
column3: Opstigningen

column2: This campaign is thought of as an introductory campaign. You begin as a small shopkeeper in Luebeck and have to advance to a Patrician in Luebeck within four years. During the campaign, you will receive hints and instructions, in the form of personal news, on how best to achieve your aims.
column3: Denne kampagne er taenkt som en introduktionskampagne. I begynder som lille hoeker i Luebeck og skal inden for fire aar avancere til patricier i Luebeck. Under kampagnen faar I tips og anvisninger i form af personlige beskeder om, hvordan I bedst naar jeres maal.

column2: The flying trader
column3: Den flyvende koebmand

column2: You are a young small shopkeeper from a rich Luebeck family. Your private tutor gave you a good comprehensive education, which even at that time anticipated the enlightening spirit of the renaissance. The world to which you are going is marked by deep religiousness and a sailor's superstitious belief in the ship's kobold. Will you make its as a competent trader in this world, as your father before you?
column3: I er en ung, lille hoeker fra en rig familie i Luebeck. Jeres huslaerer gav jer en god og bred uddannelse, som allerede varslede renaessancens oplyste aand. Den verden, I traeder ind i, er praeget af dyb religioesitet og soemaendenes overtroiske tro paa skibsnissen. Vil I kunne goere jer gaeldende i denne verden som en dygtig handelsmand, ligesom jeres far foer jer?

column2: Campaign: Rise of the Hanseatic League
column3: Kampagne: Hansaens opsving

column2:
The Hanseatic League is in an appalling state. Corruption and pirates have been the ruin of many a town.
You have been away for many years voyaging south in search of new countries and business opportunities. On your return you find your business in tatters. The once prosperous town of Rostock, your hometown that you helped to thrive, seems to have been set back to almost the state you found it in.
Your friends on the council, however, have not forgotten you. Your hard work and honesty made you a well-respected and highly trusted council member. They therefore put their faith in you to rebuild the Hanseatic League. You will receive whatever support they can offer. Just don't expect too much.
Your first task is to get your operation in Rostock back up to speed. Once this is achieved, you can then turn your attentions to the other towns. You goal is to double the number of inhabitants in the Hanseatic League over the next 15 months.
Not an easy task, but achievable.
column3:
Hansaen er i en soergelig forfatning. Korruption og pirater har vaeret mangen bys undergang.
I har i mange aar vaeret paa rejser sydpaa paa jagt efter nye lande og forretningsmuligheder. Ved jeres hjemkomst finder I jeres forretning i ruiner. Den engang saa velstaaende by Rostock, jeres hjemby, som I hjalp til at blomstre, synes at vaere faldet tilbage naesten til den tilstand, I i sin tid fandt den i.
Jeres venner i raadet har dog ikke glemt jer. Jeres haarde arbejde og aerlighed gjorde jer til et hoejt respekteret og betroet raadsmedlem. Derfor saetter de deres lid til, at I genopbygger Hansaen. I faar al den stoette, de kan give. Forvent bare ikke for meget.
Jeres foerste opgave er at faa jeres forretning i Rostock op at koere igen. Naar det er naaet, kan I vende jer mod de andre byer. Jeres maal er at fordoble antallet af indbyggere i Hansaen i loebet af de naeste 15 maaneder.
Ingen let opgave, men den kan klares.

column2: Mission: Reorganisation
column3: Mission: Saneringen

column2: How could this have happened? You have just returned from a cultural visit to the Mediterranean and severely regret your decision of entrusting your business to your cousin. In a few short months his sterling efforts have ensured that the business has almost reached a total state of collapse. Your accountants are wringing their hands, your workers and crews are scared for their jobs and the citizens fear an economic disaster.\nYou are going to have to roll your sleeves up and get stuck in. Over the next 3 months your fortune has got to be restored to exactly the same level as before you left. And that used to be a cool 3 million!
column3: Hvordan kunne det ske? I er netop kommet hjem fra en dannelsesrejse til Middelhavet og fortryder bittert, at I betroede jeres forretning til jeres faetter. Paa faa korte maaneder har hans prisvaerdige anstrengelser bragt forretningen naesten til total sammenbrud. Jeres bogholdere vrider haenderne, jeres arbejdere og besaetninger frygter for deres job, og borgerne frygter en oekonomisk katastrofe.\nI maa smoege aermerne op og tage fat. I loebet af de naeste 3 maaneder skal jeres formue bringes tilbage til noejagtig samme niveau som foer jeres afrejse. Og det var hele 3 millioner!

column2: Mission: Poor Harvest
column3: Mission: Misvaekst

column2: A late spring and relatively cool summer has caused a poor wheat harvest throughout the Hanseatic League area. Autumn already sees most of the wheat stocks depleted. The prospect of a severe famine threatens to empty the towns of its citizens.\nFortunately you have invested in fish and meat production facilities. Your task begins in November 1357. You have fisherman's huts in your hometown of Luebeck and cattle farms in Aalborg. You also have quite a bit of stock at your disposal. You should use your stocks of wheat and beer wisely, you will not be able to replenish them.\nYou will have succeeded in your task if the total population in the Hanseatic League area has not been reduced by more than 4000 inhabitants by the end of March, when wheat production restarts.
column3: Et sent foraar og en forholdsvis koelig sommer har givet en daarlig hvedehoest i hele Hansaens omraade. Allerede om efteraaret er de fleste hvedelagre opbrugt. Udsigten til en alvorlig hungersnoed truer med at toemme byerne for indbyggere.\nHeldigvis har I investeret i produktionsanlaeg for fisk og koed. Jeres opgave begynder i november 1357. I har fiskerhytter i jeres hjemby Luebeck og kvaegbrug i Aalborg. I har ogsaa et paent lager til raadighed. Brug jeres lagre af hvede og oel med omtanke, for I vil ikke kunne fylde dem op igen.\nI har loest opgaven, hvis den samlede befolkning i Hansaens omraade ikke er faldet med mere end 4000 indbyggere ved udgangen af marts, naar hvedeproduktionen starter igen.

column2: Mission: The Fire
column3: Mission: Branden

column2: You are a rich merchant in Luebeck. Your task starts a week before a large outbreak of fire there, which will see many of your buildings go up in flames. Your task is to rebuild the town after the fire. You have got 6 months to get the number of inhabitants up to the same level as before the fire.
column3: I er en rig koebmand i Luebeck. Jeres opgave begynder en uge foer en stor brand dér, som vil laegge mange af jeres bygninger i aske. Jeres opgave er at genopbygge byen efter branden. I har 6 maaneder til at bringe antallet af indbyggere op paa samme niveau som foer branden.

column2: Mission: The Black Death
column3: Mission: Den sorte doed

column2: The year of 1347 saw the beginnings of the great plague. This massive epidemic started in the Mediterranean and then gradually spread Northwest and later eastwards. Times of great economic uncertainty and disaster began in all countries bordering the Baltic and North Sea, with England being particularly badly affected. Sea trade was disrupted massively.\nYou start this mission as a travelling merchant in Gdansk in the year of 1349, shortly before the plague breaks out in London. You have about a month before the plague will start spreading through the German towns of Cologne, Hamburg, Bremen, Luebeck, Rostock and Gdansk. Your task is to supply these towns during the epidemic, and to help them prosper again once the plague has passed. Timely boosting of a town's healthcare provisions can influence the plague's duration and spread.\nThe original number of inhabitants in the Hanseatic League needs to be restored within 4 months of this mission's start to have successfully completed this mission.
column3: Aaret 1347 saa begyndelsen paa den store pest. Denne voldsomme epidemi begyndte i Middelhavsomraadet og bredte sig derefter gradvis mod nordvest og senere mod oest. En tid med stor oekonomisk usikkerhed og katastrofer begyndte i alle lande omkring Oestersoeen og Nordsoeen, og England blev saerlig haardt ramt. Soehandelen blev voldsomt forstyrret.\nI begynder denne mission som rejsende koebmand i Gdansk i aaret 1349, kort foer pesten bryder ud i London. I har omkring en maaned, foer pesten begynder at brede sig gennem de tyske byer Cologne, Hamburg, Bremen, Luebeck, Rostock og Gdansk. Jeres opgave er at forsyne disse byer under epidemien og hjaelpe dem til at blomstre igen, naar pesten er drevet over. Ved i tide at styrke en bys sundhedsvaesen kan I paavirke pestens varighed og udbredelse.\nFor at loese missionen skal det oprindelige antal indbyggere i Hansaen vaere genoprettet inden for 4 maaneder efter missionens start.

column2: \\f1_Welcome to Patrician 3, the maritime trading simulation set in the period of the Hanseatic League.\nIn this introduction, you will learn how to develop from a simple shopkeeper to a travelling merchant.\nYou can use the two buttons to the right of this text to move forwards and backwards between each step of this tutorial.
column3: \\f1_Velkommen til Patrician 3, handelssimulationen til soes i Hansaens tid.\nI denne indfoering laerer I, hvordan I udvikler jer fra almindelig koebmand til rejsende handelsmand.\nMed de to knapper til hoejre for teksten kan I gaa frem og tilbage mellem trinene i denne oevelse.

column2:
\f1_The tutorial is divided into several parts. In this part you will learn about the operation of the game console.

\f0_Instructions
\f1_You should choose an interface resolution of at least 1024 x 768 for this tutorial.
column3:
\f1_Oevelsen er delt op i flere dele. I denne del laerer I at betjene spillets brugerflade.

\f0_Anvisninger
\f1_Til denne oevelse boer I vaelge en skaermoploesning paa mindst 1024 x 768.

column2: \\f1_Let us first look at the divisions of the game interface layout. It consists of five parts.\n\\f0_Main view\n\\f1_Towns and the nautical maps are shown here. At the beginning of a game you will always start in your home town, which, in this case, is Lubeck.
column3: \\f1_Lad os foerst se paa, hvordan spillets brugerflade er inddelt. Den bestaar af fem dele.\n\\f0_Hovedvisning\n\\f1_Her vises byerne og soekortene. I begyndelsen af et spil starter I altid i jeres hjemby, som i dette tilfaelde er Luebeck.

column2: \\f1_The main view only shows a section of the town. Move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen or use the arrows on the keyboard to change the view
column3: \\f1_Hovedvisningen viser kun en del af byen. Flyt musemarkoeren til skaermkanten, eller brug piletasterne paa tastaturet for at aendre visningen.

column2: \\f0_Mini-Map\n\\f1_Shows the whole area of the town. The rectangle indicates the displayed area. Change this display by using the mouse to move the rectangle.
column3: \\f0_Minikort\n\\f1_Viser hele byens omraade. Rektanglet viser den del, der vises. Aendr visningen ved at flytte rektanglet med musen.

column2: \\f0_Title Bar\n\\f1_The title bar is placed at the top of the screen. If you are in a town, it will show the following, from left to right: population, the name of the town, the number of your buildings in the town, your money and the date.\nThere are also buttons hidden behind the small symbols on the title bar.
column3: \\f0_Titellinje\n\\f1_Titellinjen sidder oeverst paa skaermen. Hvis I er i en by, viser den fra venstre mod hoejre: indbyggertal, byens navn, antallet af jeres bygninger i byen, jeres penge og datoen.\nBag de smaa symboler i titellinjen er der desuden skjulte knapper.

column2: \\f0_Population Button\n\\f1_Click onto the population symbol in order to see the population distribution and the satisfaction of the citizens of this town. If arrows are visible behind satisfaction, then they indicate whether the citizens are becoming more, or less satisfied.
column3: \\f0_Knappen Befolkning\n\\f1_Klik paa befolkningssymbolet for at se fordelingen af indbyggerne og tilfredsheden hos byens borgere. Hvis der er pile bag tilfredsheden, viser de, om borgerne bliver mere eller mindre tilfredse.

column2: \\f0_Building Button\n\\f1_The building symbol changes the view of a building. You use it to differentiate between your own and other buildings.
column3: \\f0_Knappen Bygninger\n\\f1_Bygningssymbolet aendrer visningen af bygninger. Med den skelner I mellem jeres egne og andres bygninger.

column2: \\f0_Money Button\n\\f1_If you click the money symbol, a window with the statistics menu will be opened. However, this menu will not be explained in this tutorial. To close a window, either click onto the close button at the bottom right hand corner of the window, or right click.
column3: \\f0_Knappen Penge\n\\f1_Hvis I klikker paa pengesymbolet, aabnes et vindue med statistikmenuen. Denne menu forklares dog ikke i denne oevelse. For at lukke et vindue klikker I paa lukkeknappen nederst i vinduets hoejre hjoerne eller hoejreklikker.

column2: \\f0_Chronicle\n\\f1The chronicle is hidden behind the hourglass. The chronicle contains important public information. It is worth looking into it every so often, to keep yourself up-to-date about events in the Hanse. Close the chronicle by using either the close button or a right click.
column3: \\f0_Kroenike\n\\f1Kroeniken er skjult bag timeglasset. Kroeniken indeholder vigtige offentlige oplysninger. Det kan betale sig at kigge i den en gang imellem for at holde sig ajour med begivenhederne i Hansaen. Luk kroeniken med lukkeknappen eller med et hoejreklik.

column2: \\f0_Selection or Election Window\n\\f1_Information about selected ships is displayed here. Now, let us test it.\nShift the cursor to the harbour of the town. You will see a ship by the name of "Viking". This is your ship. Click on it in order to select it.
column3: \\f0_Udvalgsvindue\n\\f1_Her vises oplysninger om de valgte skibe. Lad os proeve det.\nFlyt markoeren til byens havn. I ser et skib ved navn "Viking". Det er jeres skib. Klik paa det for at vaelge det.

column2: \\f1_The selection window will now display information about the selected ship. You will see the ship's location under its name. If it is sent somewhere else, you will also see the destination here. The ship's load is next to it. The uppermost number shows the capacity; the number in the middle shows how much space goods have taken up. Finally, the number below shows how much space is required for crew and armament.
column3: \\f1_Udvalgsvinduet viser nu oplysninger om det valgte skib. Under navnet ser I, hvor skibet befinder sig. Hvis det sendes et andet sted hen, ser I ogsaa destinationen her. Ved siden af staar skibets last. Det oeverste tal angiver kapaciteten; tallet i midten viser, hvor meget plads varerne fylder. Det nederste tal viser endelig, hvor meget plads der kraeves til besaetning og bevaebning.

column2: \\f1_Apart from that, the ship's speed in knots, the condition of the ship from 0 to 100%, and the crew are displayed here.\nNext to that is the armament strength of the ship.
column3: \\f1_Desuden vises her skibets fart i knob, skibets tilstand fra 0 til 100 % og besaetningen.\nVed siden af staar skibets bevaebningsstyrke.

column2: \\f1_Under that, you will see a list of all the goods on board. Note that there are two units of measurement: load and barrels. One load equals exactly 10 barrels.
column3: \\f1_Under det ser I en liste over alle varer om bord. Bemaerk, at der er to maaleenheder: laes og toende. Et laes svarer noejagtigt til 10 toender.

column2: \\f0_Button Bar\n\\f1_Let's look at the button bar and go through them from left to right.\nThe first button displays the list of ships. Please click it.
column3: \\f0_Knapraekke\n\\f1_Lad os se paa knapraekken og gennemgaa knapperne fra venstre mod hoejre.\nDen foerste knap viser skibslisten. Klik paa den.

column2: \\f1_You can see which ships belong to you, what their names are, and where they are at the moment. You only have one ship in this tutorial; therefore the ship's list is displaying one ship only.\nThe ship list shows the name, type of ship, status and location, load and the value of the goods on board. You can switch between the display showing crew and armament by using the button below the list.
column3: \\f1_I kan se, hvilke skibe der tilhoerer jer, hvad de hedder, og hvor de befinder sig lige nu. I denne oevelse har I kun ét skib; derfor viser skibslisten kun ét skib.\nSkibslisten viser navn, skibstype, status og placering, last og vaerdien af varerne om bord. Med knappen under listen skifter I mellem visning af besaetning og bevaebning.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, there is a "go to" button to the left of each ship in the ship-list. If you click on this button, it will go to the spot where the ship is placed. This can be in another town or at sea. Try it out, in order to bring the ship "Viking" into your field of vision.\nThen close the ship list.
column3: \\f1_Til venstre for hvert skib paa skibslisten er der i oevrigt en knap "gaa til". Hvis I klikker paa den, gaar visningen til det sted, hvor skibet er, hvilket kan vaere i en anden by eller paa havet. Proev det for at faa skibet "Viking" ind i synsfeltet.\nLuk derefter skibslisten.

column2: \\f1_The next button is the fast-forward. If you press it, the running time will be speeded up. Meanwhile, you can follow all your ships on the complete map. The fast-forward ends as soon as you press a mouse button, or one of your ships goes to anchor in a harbour.
column3: \\f1_Den naeste knap er spol frem. Hvis I trykker paa den, gaar tiden hurtigere. Imens kan I foelge alle jeres skibe paa det samlede kort. Spol frem stopper, saa snart I trykker paa en museknap, eller et af jeres skibe kaster anker i en havn.

column2: \\f1_The news menu is hidden behind the next button. All the letters you have received are filed here. Click on this button and you will see the news menu, in which various news items have been filed. Click onto one of the topics and then onto news-item, in order to read it.\nClose the news, in the same way as with all other windows by using the close button or with a right click.
column3: \\f1_Nyhedsmenuen er skjult bag den naeste knap. Alle de breve, I modtager, arkiveres her. Klik paa knappen, saa ser I nyhedsmenuen, hvor forskellige nyheder er arkiveret. Klik paa et af emnerne og derefter paa en nyhed for at laese den.\nLuk nyhederne som alle andre vinduer med lukkeknappen eller med et hoejreklik.

column2: \\f1_You can use the last but one button on the news menu to configure the letters-file so that letters can automatically be deleted later on. You can also delete a letter by clicking it and then clicking the "delete" button on the right of the news menu.
column3: \\f1_Med den naestsidste knap i nyhedsmenuen kan I indstille brevarkivet, saa breve slettes automatisk senere. I kan ogsaa slette et brev ved at klikke paa det og derefter paa knappen "slet" til hoejre i nyhedsmenuen.

column2: \\f1_The next button on the button bar is the construction menu. You can use this menu to construct buildings in towns where you have a trading office. The trading office is simultaneously the home, office and warehouse of a trader.\nTrading office and building menu will be explained in the chapter after the next.
column3: \\f1_Den naeste knap paa knapraekken er byggemenuen. Med denne menu bygger I bygninger i byer, hvor I har et handelskontor. Handelskontoret er paa én gang en koebmands hjem, kontor og lager.\nHandelskontoret og byggemenuen forklares i kapitlet efter det naeste.

column2: \\f1_If you click the town gate button, you leave the town and end up on the sea map.\nInstead of the town, the sea map will be displayed. You can as usual shift the clip by using the arrow keys on the keyboard.
column3: \\f1_Hvis I klikker paa knappen med byporten, forlader I byen og kommer til soekortet.\nI stedet for byen vises soekortet. Som saedvanlig kan I flytte visningen med piletasterne paa tastaturet.

column2: \\f1_All towns, and your ships will be displayed on the sea map. Naval events and foreign ships are also visible here.\nYou can enter any town in which you have ships or buildings from this map. In this tutorial, you are only represented in Lubeck.
column3: \\f1_Paa soekortet vises alle byer og jeres skibe. Soebegivenheder og fremmede skibe er ogsaa synlige her.\nFra dette kort kan I gaa ind i enhver by, hvor I har skibe eller bygninger. I denne oevelse er I kun repraesenteret i Luebeck.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, the title bar has changed. As you are no longer in a town, four ship buttons are displayed. You can switch between ships using these buttons. However, there will be differences between anchored and sailing ships, and convoys.
column3: \\f1_Titellinjen har i oevrigt aendret sig. Da I ikke laengere er i en by, vises fire skibsknapper. Med dem skifter I mellem skibe. Der er dog forskel paa skibe for anker, sejlende skibe og konvojer.

column2: \\f1_Apart from that the display will show how many ships are at anchor in a harbour or waiting for new orders.\nShips that are at the shipyard for repairs or expansion are not shown, because they cannot be given orders.
column3: \\f1_Desuden viser skaermen, hvor mange skibe der ligger for anker i en havn eller venter paa nye ordrer.\nSkibe, der ligger paa vaerftet til reparation eller udbygning, vises ikke, fordi de ikke kan faa ordrer.

column2: \\f1_To leave the map and get back to Lubeck, click the blue button near Lubeck on the map. The last button on the far right of the button bar takes you to the options-menu. You can load games and save them, as well as ending the game here.
column3: \\f1_For at forlade kortet og vende tilbage til Luebeck skal I klikke paa den blaa knap ved Luebeck paa kortet. Den sidste knap yderst til hoejre paa knapraekken foerer til indstillingsmenuen. Her kan I indlaese og gemme spil samt afslutte spillet.

column2: \\f1_Yet another tip for operating with the mouse:\nYou can select objects such as ships and buildings by using the left click. By using a right click you can send the selected ship to another location. Apart from that, the right click is used to close a window in the main view.
column3: \\f1_Endnu et tip til brugen af musen:\nMed venstreklik vaelger I objekter som skibe og bygninger. Med hoejreklik sender I det valgte skib til et andet sted. Desuden bruges hoejreklik til at lukke et vindue i hovedvisningen.

column2: \\f1_Tutorial 1 ends here. Click on the "continue" button to end this chapter and to start the next one. Or select "End game" in the options-menu, to get back to the main menu.
column3: \\f1_Oevelse 1 slutter her. Klik paa knappen "fortsaet" for at afslutte dette kapitel og starte det naeste. Eller vaelg "Afslut spillet" i indstillingsmenuen for at vende tilbage til hovedmenuen.

column2: \\f1_Welcome to chapter two of the tutorial. In this part of the tutorial, we will have a closer look at the ships, including areas such as travelling and the signing up of captain and crew.\nNow click the forward button to continue.
column3: \\f1_Velkommen til oevelsens andet kapitel. I denne del ser vi naermere paa skibene, herunder emner som rejser og hyring af kaptajn og besaetning.\nKlik nu paa fremadknappen for at fortsaette.

column2: \\f1_You are in the town of Lubeck. Move the displayed area to the harbour and select the ship "Viking" by left clicking on it. The ship will then appear in the lower right selection window.\nNow look at this window in detail.
column3: \\f1_I befinder jer i byen Luebeck. Flyt visningen til havnen, og vaelg skibet "Viking" med et venstreklik. Skibet vises saa i udvalgsvinduet nederst til hoejre.\nSe nu naermere paa dette vindue.

column2: \\f1_There is an anchor and the town name, Lubeck, underneath the name of the ship. The anchor and the location indicate that the ship is at anchor in Lubeck. Instead of an anchor there could be another symbol, for example, when the ship is at sea, but we will come to that later.
column3: \\f1_Under skibets navn er der et anker og byens navn, Luebeck. Ankeret og stedet viser, at skibet ligger for anker i Luebeck. I stedet for et anker kan der vaere et andet symbol, for eksempel naar skibet er paa havet, men det kommer vi til senere.

column2: \\f1_In the line below, the display will first of all show the speed of the ship in knots. Of course, in the habour the speed shown is 0. Next to that you will see the condition of the ship, which, at the moment is 100%, the ship is therefore in tip-top condition.
column3: \\f1_Paa linjen nedenunder viser skaermen foerst skibets fart i knob. I havnen er farten naturligvis 0. Ved siden af ser I skibets tilstand, som lige nu er 100 %; skibet er altsaa i topform.

column2: \\f1_To the right you see the crew and armament of the ship. The figure indicates the number of sailors on board. The star means that there is a captain on board.\nThere are large and small balls displayed under the weapons symbol. Only a maximum of five balls can be displayed here, five small balls are equal to one large ball.
column3: \\f1_Til hoejre ser I skibets besaetning og bevaebning. Tallet angiver antallet af soemaend om bord. Stjernen betyder, at der er en kaptajn om bord.\nUnder vaabensymbolet vises store og smaa kugler. Der kan hoejst vises fem kugler; fem smaa kugler svarer til en stor.

column2: \\f1_The large barrel shows the ship's load. As already mentioned, the uppermost figure to the right of the barrel shows the ship's capacity. How much space goods have taken up is indicated underneath. The lowest figure shows how much space isrequired for the crew and the weapons. As there are no goods on board now, the mid-figure is at 0.
column3: \\f1_Den store toende viser skibets last. Som allerede naevnt angiver det oeverste tal til hoejre for toenden skibets kapacitet. Nedenunder vises det, hvor meget plads varerne fylder. Det nederste tal viser, hvor meget plads der kraeves til besaetning og vaaben. Da der ikke er nogen varer om bord nu, staar tallet i midten paa 0.

column2: \\f1_Later on, the list of goods will be displayed in the blank space below these instructions.
column3: \\f1_Senere vises varelisten i det tomme felt under disse anvisninger.

column2: \\f1_Let's now move on to the other buttons in the ship's menu. First of all, there is the crew information. Click the "crew" button. This once again shows the number of sailors and the amount of their daily pay. As the ship is at anchor, you can dismiss sailors and captain. However, you shouldn't do that now.
column3: \\f1_Lad os nu gaa videre til de andre knapper i skibsmenuen. Foerst er der besaetningsoplysningerne. Klik paa knappen "besaetning". Den viser igen antallet af soemaend og beloebet paa deres daglige loen. Da skibet ligger for anker, kan I afskedige soemaend og kaptajn. Det boer I dog ikke goere nu.

column2: \\f1_Below the captain you can see three values: Trading bonus, travel bonus and naval battle bonus. A captain has the following standing. The older he is, the more experienced he is.\nThe other buttons in the ship's menu are not too interesting during the first few hours of the game and are explained in the handbook.
column3: \\f1_Under kaptajnen ser I tre vaerdier: handelsbonus, rejsebonus og soeslagsbonus. En kaptajn har foelgende anseelse. Jo aeldre han er, desto mere erfaren er han.\nDe oevrige knapper i skibsmenuen er ikke saa interessante i spillets foerste timer og forklares i haandbogen.

column2: \\f1_We will now send the ship to another town. To do that, you have to select a ship. Now click the button, "leave town" on the button bar above the ship's menu.\nThis will display the large sea map.
